author: James Bruton
description:
#ad The @LEGO Group asked me to build a mega musical karaoke organ. I used seven LEGO Star Wars SMART Play Mos Eisley Cantina Sets, fourteen SMART Bricks and fourteen different Minifigures. I built a structure and mechanics so that all fourteen SMART Bricks move in sync, and you can select which character sings along.
#LEGOPartner #SMARTPlay #TheGalaxyPlayBack #LEGOStarWars
title: LEGO Star Wars SMART Play Karaoke Machine
